description:
Traffic summary for one website over a date range.

    Returns total visits, top countries, top pages, which AI bots read
    the site (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and others), the most clicked
    buttons, and notable changes. Use this when the user asks how a site
    is doing. Get the site_id from list_websites first.

    Args:
        site_id: One of the site_ids returned by list_websites.
        start_date: Range start, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive).
        end_date: Range end, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive), at most 90 days
            after start_date.

    Without sign-in only the public demo site works.
name: website_summary
title: Website Traffic Summary
